newsitem.title: USA: IGI sees Q2 revenue similar to 1996 figure.
newsitem.headline: IGI sees Q2 revenue similar to 1996 figure.

text.p: IGI Inc said on Monday that the U.S. Department of Agriculture allowed it to ship additonal poultry vaccines from its Vineland Laboratories unit, which should help the company report second-quarter revenues similar to those from the same period a year ago.

The USDA in June ordered IGI to suspend shipments of 36 of the 80 licensed vaccines made by Vineland, citing alleged statutory violations. But as of June 30, 18 of those 36 had been released by the USDA, IGI said in a news release.
The company said it expects the remaining 18 to be released soon, adding that it does not expect the USDA's action in ordering the suspension to materially affect its future business operations.
IGI makes animal health products, and also skin care and consumer products.
